purpose: Maps every item of the frozen scored minimum (governing 7.0 workplan section 8.3 as amended through the ratified [7.2.1 amendment] annotations M1-M10: elements 1-7 and their role map, every label-table row including 'inaccessible home', the delegate questions with qualifiers, the gap rule, the re-evaluation rule, the (a)-(c) rule) to its exact phrase(s) in the generated Scientific checks section, and names each meaning the amendment removed with its amendment location. Written by the D4 author; the independent mapping check is a separate context's job. Each phrase must occur verbatim (whitespace-normalized) in the generated entrypoint of every route listed; an element-specific item must not occur on routes it does not list. Each removed item lists the former entrypoint wording that must no longer occur on any route.

visible_structure: Element numbers are workplan identifiers (section 8.3) and are not shown. Each element's duties are named bullets (element_labels): duties that keep a result's status recoverable under 'Keep scientific results' status recoverable:', separate rules under 'Rules:'. Cross-references inside the section are by name: 'Variants' refers to the variant delegate question (always carried with element 2), 'Persisting a tension' refers to 'Persistence' (element 1, always carried with element 3).
